### Will Graham Devotion: How the Cross Met Our 4 Greatest Needs
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/articles/will-graham-devotion-how-the-cross-met-our-4-greatest-needs
Passage: Isaiah 53:5
Points:
- Isaiah 53:5 powerfully displays both human brokenness and Christ's sacrifice.
- Jesus shed His blood to grant forgiveness for our rebellion against God.
- Because guilty humanity deserved death, Christ stepped in as our substitute.
- He bore God's wrath on the cross to settle our debt and establish peace.
- His wounds provide spiritual healing and new life to dying souls.

### The Power of Christ’s Pain for You - Powerpoint - March 12
Author: Dr. Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-march-29-2013.html
Passage: Isaiah 53:5
Points:
- Traditional religious artwork often masks the true brutality of the crucifixion.
- Christ endured public degradation, cursing, and agonizing pain for our sake.
- Suspended on the cross, He was rejected by men and judged by God for our sins.
- No depiction can fully convey the weight of Christ bearing the world's sins.
- Believers should continually thank Jesus for enduring unimaginable pain to redeem us.
